description: Render provenance figure: EIF4E2 GO evidence-code table (highlighting IBA GO:0016281) plus paralog identity and cap-binding residue conservation
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def get(a):
    return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",
                        headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}, timeout=30).json()

# ---- EIF4E2 GO evidence codes (recompute for provenance) ----
j=get("O60573")
rows=[]
key_order=["GO:0016281","GO:0003743","GO:0006413","GO:0098808","GO:0000340",
           "GO:0045947","GO:0017148","GO:0035278","GO:0072344"]
gomap={}
for x in j.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[]):
    if x["database"]=="GO":
        term=[p["value"] for p in x.get("properties",[]) if p["key"]=="GoTerm"]
        ev=[p["value"] for p in x.get("properties",[]) if p["key"]=="GoEvidenceType"]
        gomap[x["id"]]=(term[0] if term else "", ev[0] if ev else "")
for gid in key_order:
    if gid in gomap:
        term,ev=gomap[gid]
        code=ev.split(":")[0]
        kind="phylogenetic/IEA (weak)" if code in ("IBA","IEA","ISS","ISM","IGC","RCA") else "experimental"
        rows.append([gid, term[:52], ev, kind])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8.6),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[3,1]})
ax=axes[0]; ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("EIF4E2 (O60573): current GO annotations & evidence codes (UniProt/GO Central, fetched 2026-09)",
             fontsize=11,weight="bold",loc="left")
tbl=ax.table(cellText=rows,
             colLabels=["GO ID","Term","Evidence","Evidence class"],
             loc="center",cellLoc="left",colWidths=[0.12,0.44,0.20,0.24])
tbl.auto_set_font_size(False); tbl.set_fontsize(9); tbl.scale(1,1.5)
for (r,c),cell in tbl.get_celld().items():
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#2c3e50"); cell.set_text_props(color="white",weight="bold")
    elif rows[r-1][0]=="GO:0016281": cell.set_facecolor("#ffe08a")  # the hypothesis term
    elif "experimental" in rows[r-1][3]: cell.set_facecolor("#d5f5e3")
    else: cell.set_facecolor("#fdecea")

# ---- paralog identity + cap-Trp conservation ----
ax2=axes[1]; ax2.axis("off")
note=[
 ["EIF4E2 vs EIF4E1 identity","35.8% (76/212, BLOSUM62 global NW)"],
 ["EIF4E2 vs EIF4E3 identity","31.1% (68/219)"],
 ["Cap-binding W (eIF4E1 W56 equiv.)","EIF4E2 = Tyr (Y)  -> Trp->Tyr substitution"],
 ["Cap-binding W (eIF4E1 W102 equiv.)","EIF4E2 = Trp (W)  -> CONSERVED"],
 ["MF GO:0031370 eIF4G binding","EIF4E1: YES | EIF4E2: ABSENT"],
 ["UniProt curated SUBUNIT","'Does not interact with eIF4G (EIF4G1/2/3)' (By similarity)"],
]
t2=ax2.table(cellText=note,colLabels=["Feature","Value"],loc="center",cellLoc="left",
             colWidths=[0.34,0.66])
t2.auto_set_font_size(False); t2.set_fontsize(9); t2.scale(1,1.5)
for (r,c),cell in t2.get_celld().items():
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#34495e"); cell.set_text_props(color="white",weight="bold")
ax2.set_title("Sequence/annotation checks: EIF4E2 retains cap binding (Tyr/Trp sandwich) but lacks canonical eIF4G-binding",
              fontsize=10,weight="bold",loc="left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("/tmp/eif4e2_go_evidence_provenance.png",dpi=130,bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print("Figure rendered. Key point: GO:0016281 on EIF4E2 is IBA (phylogenetic), not experimental.")
